sanskrit: viditvā sapta sūkṣmāṇi ṣaḍaṅgaṃ tvāṃ ca mūrtitaḥ pradhānavidhiyogasthas tvām eva viśate budhaḥ
english: Having known the seven subtle principles and you who are six-membered in your embodied form, the wise one, established in the discipline of the ordering of primal matter, enters into you alone.

sanskrit: evam ukte mayā pārtha bhave cārtivināśane carācaraṃ jagat sarvaṃ siṃhanādam athākarot
english: When I had spoken thus, O Pārtha, to Bhava the destroyer of affliction, the whole world, moving and unmoving, raised up a lion's roar.

sanskrit: saviprasaṃghāś ca surāsurāś ca; nāgāḥ piśācāḥ pitaro vayāṃsi rakṣogaṇā bhūtagaṇāś ca sarve; maharṣayaś caiva tathā praṇemuḥ
english: The hosts of brāhmaṇas, the gods and the asuras, the nāgas, the piśācas, the ancestral fathers and the birds, the throngs of rākṣasas and all the bands of spirits, and the great seers as well, then bowed down in reverence.

sanskrit: mama mūrdhni ca divyānāṃ kusumānāṃ sugandhinām rāśayo nipatanti sma vāyuś ca susukho vavau
english: Upon my head heaps of fragrant celestial flowers came showering down, and a most pleasant breeze blew.

sanskrit: nirīkṣya bhagavān devīm umāṃ māṃ ca jagaddhitaḥ śatakratuṃ cābhivīkṣya svayaṃ mām āha śaṃkaraḥ
english: The Lord, the benefactor of the world, having looked upon the goddess Umā and upon me, and having gazed at Śatakratu, Śaṃkara himself spoke to me.

sanskrit: vidmaḥ kṛṣṇa parāṃ bhaktim asmāsu tava śatruhan kriyatām ātmanaḥ śreyaḥ prītir hi paramā tvayi
english: We know, O Kṛṣṇa, your supreme devotion to us, O slayer of foes; let your own welfare be secured, for our love for you is supreme.

sanskrit: vṛṇīṣvāṣṭau varān kṛṣṇa dātāsmi tava sattama brūhi yādavaśārdūla yān icchasi sudurlabhān
english: Choose eight boons, O Kṛṣṇa; I shall grant them to you, O most excellent one. Speak, O tiger among the Yādavas, of whatever boons, however hard to obtain, you desire.

sanskrit: kṛṣṇa uvāca mūrdhnā nipatya niyatas tejaḥsaṃnicaye tataḥ paramaṃ harṣam āgamya bhagavantam athābruvam
english: Kṛṣṇa said: Falling down with my head upon that mass of splendor, self-controlled, and then attaining the highest joy, I addressed the Lord.

sanskrit: dharme dṛḍhatvaṃ yudhi śatrughātaṃ; yaśas tathāgryaṃ paramaṃ balaṃ ca yogapriyatvaṃ tava saṃnikarṣaṃ; vṛṇe sutānāṃ ca śataṃ śatāni
english: Firmness in dharma, the slaying of foes in battle, foremost renown and supreme strength, devotion to yoga, nearness to you, and a hundred times a hundred sons — these I choose.

sanskrit: evam astv iti tad vākyaṃ mayoktaḥ prāha śaṃkaraḥ
english: "So be it" — these words Śaṃkara spoke, having been addressed by me.

sanskrit: tato māṃ jagato mātā dharaṇī sarvapāvanī uvācomā praṇihitā śarvāṇī tapasāṃ nidhiḥ
english: Then the mother of the world, Umā the all-purifying Earth, intent and composed — Śarvāṇī, the treasury of austerities — spoke to me.

sanskrit: datto bhagavatā putraḥ sāmbo nāma tavānagha matto 'py aṣṭau varān iṣṭān gṛhāṇa tvaṃ dadāmi te praṇamya śirasā sā ca mayoktā pāṇḍunandana
english: "A son named Sāmba has been granted to you by the Lord, O sinless one; from me too receive eight cherished boons, which I give to you." And bowing my head, I addressed her, O delight of Pāṇḍu's line.

sanskrit: dvijeṣv akopaṃ pitṛtaḥ prasādaṃ; śataṃ sutānām upabhogaṃ paraṃ ca kule prītiṃ mātṛtaś ca prasādaṃ; śamaprāptiṃ pravṛṇe cāpi dākṣyam
english: Freedom from anger toward the twice-born, my father's favor, a hundred sons and the highest enjoyment, affection within my kindred and my mother's grace, the attainment of peace, and skillfulness too — these I chose.

sanskrit: devy uvāca evaṃ bhaviṣyaty amaraprabhāva; nāhaṃ mṛṣā jātu vade kadā cit bhāryāsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśaiva; tāsu priyatvaṃ ca tathākṣayatvam
english: The goddess said: "So shall it be, O you of immortal majesty; never at any time do I speak falsely. Sixteen thousand wives shall be yours, and beloved standing among them, and likewise undecaying vigor."

sanskrit: prītiṃ cāgryāṃ bāndhavānāṃ sakāśād; dadāmi te vapuṣaḥ kāmyatāṃ ca bhokṣyante vai saptatir vai śatāni; gṛhe tubhyam atithīnāṃ ca nityam
english: "Foremost affection from your kinsmen I grant you, and the loveliness of your form; and seven hundred guests shall ever feast in your house."

sanskrit: vāsudeva uvāca evaṃ dattvā varān devo mama devī ca bhārata antarhitaḥ kṣaṇe tasmin sagaṇo bhīmapūrvaja
english: Vāsudeva said: Having thus granted me boons, the god and the goddess, O Bhārata, vanished in that instant together with their attendant hosts, O elder brother of Bhīma.

sanskrit: etad atyadbhutaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇāyātitejase upamanyave mayā kṛtsnam ākhyātaṃ kauravottama
english: All this exceedingly wondrous matter I recounted in full to the brāhmaṇa Upamanyu of surpassing splendor, O best of the Kurus.

sanskrit: namaskṛtvā tu sa prāha devadevāya suvrata nāsti śarvasamo dāne nāsti śarvasamo raṇe nāsti śarvasamo devo nāsti śarvasamā gatiḥ
english: And having made obeisance to the god of gods, he of firm vows declared: "There is none equal to Śarva in giving, none equal to Śarva in battle, no god equal to Śarva, no refuge equal to Śarva."

sanskrit: ṛṣir āsīt kṛte tāta taṇḍir ity eva viśrutaḥ daśa varṣasahasrāṇi tena devaḥ samādhinā ārādhito 'bhūd bhaktena tasyodarkaṃ niśāmaya
english: There was a seer in the Kṛta age, my son, renowned by the name of Taṇḍi; for ten thousand years the god was worshipped by him, devoted, with deep meditation. Hear now the outcome that came to him.

sanskrit: sa dṛṣṭavān mahādevam astauṣīc ca stavair vibhum pavitrāṇāṃ pavitras tvaṃ gatir gatimatāṃ vara atyugraṃ tejasāṃ tejas tapasāṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ
english: He beheld Mahādeva and praised the Lord with hymns: "You are the purifier of the pure, the goal of those who seek a goal, O most excellent one; the fiercely blazing splendor of splendors, the supreme austerity of austerities."

sanskrit: viśvāvasuhiraṇyākṣapuruhūtanamaskṛta bhūrikalyāṇada vibho purusatya namo 'stu te
english: "O you to whom Viśvāvasu, Hiraṇyākṣa, and Puruhūta bow down, bestower of abundant blessings, O all-pervading Lord, O ancient truth — homage be to you!"

sanskrit: jātīmaraṇabhīrūṇāṃ yatīnāṃ yatatāṃ vibho nirvāṇada sahasrāṃśo namas te 'stu sukhāśraya
english: "For the ascetics striving in their endeavor, who dread birth and death, O all-pervading Lord, you are the giver of nirvāṇa, O thousand-rayed one; homage be to you, O abode of bliss!"

sanskrit: brahmā śatakratur viṣṇur viśvedevā maharṣayaḥ na vidus tvāṃ tu tattvena kuto vetsyāmahe vayam
english: "Brahmā, Śatakratu, Viṣṇu, the Viśvedevas, and the great seers do not know you in your true essence; how then shall we come to know you?"

sanskrit: tvattaḥ pravartate kālas tvayi kālaś ca līyate kālākhyaḥ puruṣākhyaś ca brahmākhyaś ca tvam eva hi
english: "From you time proceeds, and in you time dissolves; you alone are that which is called Time, that which is called Puruṣa, and that which is called Brahman."

sanskrit: tanavas te smṛtās tisraḥ purāṇajñaiḥ surarṣibhiḥ adhipauruṣam adhyātmam adhibhūtādhidaivatam adhilokyādhivijñānam adhiyajñas tvam eva hi
english: "Three forms of yours are recounted by the divine seers learned in ancient lore: that pertaining to the cosmic Person, to the self, and to beings and deities; and pertaining to the worlds, to higher knowledge, and to sacrifice — you alone are all these."

sanskrit: tvāṃ viditvātmadehasthaṃ durvidaṃ daivatair api vidvāṃso yānti nirmuktāḥ paraṃ bhāvam anāmayam
english: "Having known you, who dwell within the body of the self, hard to know even by the gods, the wise, set free, attain the supreme, disease-free state."

sanskrit: anicchatas tava vibho janmamṛtyur anekataḥ dvāraṃ tvaṃ svargamokṣāṇām ākṣeptā tvaṃ dadāsi ca
english: "For you, O all-pervading Lord, who desire it not, there is no birth or death in any manifold way; you are the gateway to heaven and to liberation — you both withhold and bestow."

sanskrit: tvam eva mokṣaḥ svargaś ca kāmaḥ krodhas tvam eva hi sattvaṃ rajas tamaś caiva adhaś cordhvaṃ tvam eva hi
english: "You alone are liberation and heaven; you indeed are desire and wrath; you alone are sattva, rajas, and tamas, and the below and the above."

sanskrit: brahmā viṣṇuś ca rudraś ca skandendrau savitā yamaḥ varuṇendū manur dhātā vidhātā tvaṃ dhaneśvaraḥ
english: "Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Rudra, Skanda and Indra, Savitṛ, Yama, Varuṇa and the Moon, Manu, Dhātṛ and Vidhātṛ — you are the lord of wealth, Kubera."

sanskrit: bhūr vāyur jyotir āpaś ca vāg buddhis tvaṃ matir manaḥ karma satyānṛte cobhe tvam evāsti ca nāsti ca
english: "Earth, wind, light, and the waters, speech, intellect — you are thought and mind, action, and both truth and untruth; you alone are being and non-being."

sanskrit: indriyāṇīndriyārthāś ca tatparaṃ prakṛter dhruvam viśvāviśvaparo bhāvaś cintyācintyas tvam eva hi
english: "The senses and the objects of the senses, and that abiding reality beyond primal nature — you alone are the existence transcending both the manifest and the unmanifest universe, the thinkable and the unthinkable."

sanskrit: yac caitat paramaṃ brahma yac ca tat paramaṃ padam yā gatiḥ sāṃkhyayogānāṃ sa bhavān nātra saṃśayaḥ
english: "That which is the supreme Brahman, that which is the supreme abode, and the goal of the followers of Sāṃkhya and Yoga — that are you, O Lord; herein there is no doubt."

sanskrit: nūnam adya kṛtārthāḥ sma nūnaṃ prāptāḥ satāṃ gatim yāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuvantīha jñānanirmalabuddhayaḥ
english: "Surely this day we have achieved our purpose; surely we have attained the goal of the good — that goal which here is reached by those whose minds are made pure through knowledge."

sanskrit: aho mūḍhāḥ sma suciram imaṃ kālam acetasaḥ yan na vidmaḥ paraṃ devaṃ śāśvataṃ yaṃ vidur budhāḥ
english: "Alas, for a very long time we have been deluded, devoid of understanding, in that we knew not the supreme, eternal God whom the wise know."

sanskrit: so 'yam āsāditaḥ sākṣād bahubhir janmabhir mayā bhaktānugrahakṛd devo yaṃ jñātvāmṛtam aśnute
english: "This very god, the bestower of grace upon his devotees, has now been reached by me in person through many births — the god whom, once known, one tastes immortality."

sanskrit: devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ yac ca guhyaṃ sanātanam guhāyāṃ nihitaṃ brahma durvijñeyaṃ surair api
english: "That which is the eternal secret of gods, asuras, and men — the Brahman hidden in the cave of the heart, hard to be known even by the gods —"

sanskrit: sa eṣa bhagavān devaḥ sarvakṛt sarvatomukhaḥ sarvātmā sarvadarśī ca sarvagaḥ sarvaveditā
english: "This very one is the blessed God, the maker of all, facing in every direction, the Self of all, the all-seeing, the all-pervading, the knower of all."

sanskrit: prāṇakṛt prāṇabhṛt prāṇī prāṇadaḥ prāṇināṃ gatiḥ dehakṛd dehabhṛd dehī dehabhug dehināṃ gatiḥ
english: "Maker of breath, sustainer of breath, the breathing one, giver of breath, the goal of all that breathe; maker of bodies, sustainer of bodies, the embodied one, enjoyer of bodies, the goal of all the embodied."

sanskrit: adhyātmagatiniṣṭhānāṃ dhyāninām ātmavedinām apunarmārakāmānāṃ yā gatiḥ so 'yam īśvaraḥ
english: "For those steadfast in the path of the inner self, for meditators and knowers of the Self, for those who desire no second death — the goal that is theirs, that is this Lord."

sanskrit: ayaṃ ca sarvabhūtānāṃ śubhāśubhagatipradaḥ ayaṃ ca janmamaraṇe vidadhyāt sarvajantuṣu
english: "And this one bestows upon all beings their auspicious or inauspicious destinies; and this one ordains the birth and death of all creatures."

sanskrit: ayaṃ ca siddhikāmānām ṛṣīṇāṃ siddhidaḥ prabhuḥ ayaṃ ca mokṣakāmānāṃ dvijānāṃ mokṣadaḥ prabhuḥ
english: "And this Lord is the giver of perfection to the seers who desire perfection; and this Lord is the giver of liberation to the twice-born who desire liberation."

sanskrit: bhūr ādyān sarvabhuvanān utpādya sadivaukasaḥ vibharti devas tanubhir aṣṭābhiś ca dadāti ca
english: "Having brought forth all the worlds beginning with the earth, along with the dwellers in heaven, the god sustains them with his eight bodily forms, and grants their boons."

sanskrit: ataḥ pravartate sarvam asmin sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam asmiṃś ca pralayaṃ yāti ayam ekaḥ sanātanaḥ
english: "From him everything proceeds; in him everything is established; and in him it goes to dissolution — he is the one eternal."

sanskrit: ayaṃ sa satyakāmānāṃ satyalokaḥ paraḥ satām apavargaś ca muktānāṃ kaivalyaṃ cātmavādinām
english: "This is the supreme world of truth for the good who desire truth; he is the final release of the liberated and the absolute solitude of those who proclaim the Self."

sanskrit: ayaṃ brahmādibhiḥ siddhair guhāyāṃ gopitaḥ prabhuḥ devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ na prakāśo bhaved iti
english: "This Lord is kept hidden in the cave of the heart by the perfected beings beginning with Brahmā, so that he might not be manifest to gods, asuras, and men."

sanskrit: taṃ tvāṃ devāsuranarās tattvena na vidur bhavam mohitāḥ khalv anenaiva hṛcchayena praveśitāḥ
english: "You, that Bhava, the gods, asuras, and men do not truly know, deluded indeed and led astray by this very one who dwells within the heart."

sanskrit: ye cainaṃ saṃprapadyante bhaktiyogena bhārata teṣām evātmanātmānaṃ darśayaty eṣa hṛcchayaḥ
english: "But to those who take refuge in him through the discipline of devotion, O Bhārata, this dweller in the heart reveals the Self to them by the Self."

sanskrit: yaṃ jñātvā na punarjanma maraṇaṃ cāpi vidyate yaṃ viditvā paraṃ vedyaṃ veditavyaṃ na vidyate
english: "Whom having known, there is no birth nor death again; whom having understood as the supreme object of knowledge, nothing further remains to be known."

sanskrit: yaṃ labdhvā paramaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ punaḥ prāṇasūkṣmāṃ parāṃ prāptim āgacchaty akṣayāvahām
english: "Whom having gained as the supreme gain, one deems nothing greater thereafter; one comes to that highest attainment, subtle as the breath of life, which brings the undecaying."

sanskrit: yaṃ sāṃkhyā guṇatattvajñāḥ sāṃkhyaśāstraviśāradāḥ sūkṣmajñānaratāḥ pūrvaṃ jñātvā mucyanti bandhanaiḥ
english: "Whom the followers of Sāṃkhya, knowers of the truth of the guṇas, versed in the Sāṃkhya teaching, delighting in subtle knowledge, having first known, are freed from their bonds."

sanskrit: yaṃ ca vedavido vedyaṃ vedānteṣu pratiṣṭhitam prāṇāyāmaparā nityaṃ yaṃ viśanti japanti ca
english: "Whom the knowers of the Veda know as the object of knowledge, established in the Vedānta, and whom those ever intent on breath-control enter into and ceaselessly recite."

sanskrit: ayaṃ sa devayānānām ādityo dvāram ucyate ayaṃ ca pitṛyānānāṃ candramā dvāram ucyate
english: "He, as the Sun, is called the gateway of those who travel the path of the gods; and he, as the Moon, is called the gateway of those who travel the path of the fathers."

sanskrit: eṣa kālagatiś citrā saṃvatsarayugādiṣu bhāvābhāvau tadātve ca ayane dakṣiṇottare
english: "He is the varied course of time in years, ages, and the rest, and presence and absence in the present moment, and the southern and northern courses of the sun."

sanskrit: evaṃ prajāpatiḥ pūrvam ārādhya bahubhiḥ stavaiḥ varayām āsa putratve nīlalohitasaṃjñitam
english: "Thus did Prajāpati of old, having worshipped him with many hymns, choose for his son the one named the Blue-and-Red."

sanskrit: ṛgbhir yam anuśaṃsanti tantre karmaṇi bahvṛcaḥ yajurbhir yaṃ tridhā vedyaṃ juhvaty adhvaryavo 'dhvare
english: "Whom the reciters of many ṛc-verses extol with the Ṛg verses in the ritual act, and whom, threefold to be known, the adhvaryu priests offer oblation to with the Yajus formulas in the sacrifice."

sanskrit: sāmabhir yaṃ ca gāyanti sāmagāḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ yajñasya paramā yoniḥ patiś cāyaṃ paraḥ smṛtaḥ
english: "And whom the singers of the Sāman, pure of mind, hymn with the Sāman chants — he is remembered as the supreme womb of sacrifice and its supreme lord."

sanskrit: rātryahaḥśrotranayanaḥ pakṣamāsaśirobhujaḥ ṛtuvīryas tapodhairyo hy abdaguhyorupādavān
english: "Night and day are his ears and eyes, the fortnights and months his head and arms; the seasons are his potency, austerity his firmness, the year his hidden secret, with thighs and feet of vast measure."

sanskrit: mṛtyur yamo hutāśaś ca kālaḥ saṃhāravegavān kālasya paramā yoniḥ kālaś cāyaṃ sanātanaḥ
english: "Death, Yama, and the fire-god, Time impetuous in destruction — he is the supreme source of time, and he is this eternal Time itself."

sanskrit: candrādityau sanakṣatrau sagrahau saha vāyunā dhruvaḥ saptarṣayaś caiva bhuvanāḥ sapta eva ca
english: "The moon and the sun with the constellations, with the planets and the wind, the Pole Star and the seven seers, and the seven worlds as well —"

sanskrit: pradhānaṃ mahad avyaktaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ savaikṛtam brahmādi stambaparyantaṃ bhūtādi sad asac ca yat
english: "Primal matter, the great principle, the unmanifest, ending in the particularized, together with its modifications, all from Brahmā down to a clump of grass, the elements and whatever is being and non-being —"

sanskrit: aṣṭau prakṛtayaś caiva prakṛtibhyaś ca yat param asya devasya yad bhāgaṃ kṛtsnaṃ saṃparivartate
english: "The eight constituent natures, and that which is beyond the natures — the whole of this revolves as a portion of this god."

sanskrit: etat paramam ānandaṃ yat tac chāśvatam eva ca eṣā gatir viraktānām eṣa bhāvaḥ paraḥ satām
english: "This is the supreme bliss, which is also the eternal; this is the goal of the dispassionate, this the highest state of the good."

sanskrit: etat padam anudvignam etad brahma sanātanam śāstravedāṅgaviduṣām etad dhyānaṃ paraṃ padam
english: "This is the abode free from agitation, this the eternal Brahman; for those learned in the scriptures, the Vedas, and the Vedāṅgas, this is the supreme object of meditation and the highest abode."

sanskrit: iyaṃ sā paramā kāṣṭhā iyaṃ sā paramā kalā iyaṃ sā paramā siddhir iyaṃ sā paramā gatiḥ
english: "This is that supreme limit, this that supreme part; this is that supreme perfection, this that supreme goal."

sanskrit: iyaṃ sā paramā śāntir iyaṃ sā nirvṛtiḥ parā yaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyāḥ sma ity amanyanta vedhasaḥ
english: "This is that supreme peace, this the highest beatitude, attaining which the creators thought, 'We have accomplished all that is to be done.'"

sanskrit: iyaṃ tuṣṭir iyaṃ siddhir iyaṃ śrutir iyaṃ smṛtiḥ adhyātmagatiniṣṭhānāṃ viduṣāṃ prāptir avyayā
english: "This is contentment, this is perfection, this is revelation, this is tradition; for the wise who are steadfast in the path of the inner self, this is the undecaying attainment."

sanskrit: yajatāṃ yajñakāmānāṃ yajñair vipuladakṣiṇaiḥ yā gatir daivatair divyā sā gatis tvaṃ sanātana
english: "For those who sacrifice, desiring sacrifice, with rites of abundant priestly fees, the divine goal won together with the gods — that goal are you, O eternal one."

sanskrit: japyahomavrataiḥ kṛcchrair niyamair dehapātanaiḥ tapyatāṃ yā gatir deva vairāje sā gatir bhavān
english: "For those who practice austerity through recitation, oblation, vows, penances, restraints, and the mortifying of the body, O god — the goal that lies in the Vairāja world, that goal are you."

sanskrit: karmanyāsakṛtānāṃ ca viraktānāṃ tatas tataḥ yā gatir brahmabhavane sā gatis tvaṃ sanātana
english: "For those who have renounced action and the dispassionate, here and there — the goal that lies in the abode of Brahmā, that goal are you, O eternal one."

sanskrit: apunarmārakāmānāṃ vairāgye vartatāṃ pare vikṛtīnāṃ layānāṃ ca sā gatis tvaṃ sanātana
english: "For those who desire no second death, who abide in the highest dispassion, and for the modifications dissolved back into their source — that goal are you, O eternal one."

sanskrit: jñānavijñānaniṣṭhānāṃ nirupākhyā nirañjanā kaivalyā yā gatir deva paramā sā gatir bhavān
english: "For those steadfast in knowledge and discernment, the goal that is indescribable, stainless, the absolute solitude, the supreme — that goal, O god, are you."

sanskrit: vedaśāstrapurāṇoktāḥ pañcaitā gatayaḥ smṛtāḥ tvatprasādād dhi labhyante na labhyante 'nyathā vibho
english: "These five goals, declared in the Vedas, the śāstras, and the Purāṇas, are recounted; they are won only by your grace, and otherwise are not won, O all-pervading Lord."

sanskrit: iti taṇḍis tapoyogāt tuṣṭāveśānam avyayam jagau ca paramaṃ brahma yat purā lokakṛj jagau
english: Thus Taṇḍi, through the power of his austerity, praised the imperishable Lord, and sang the supreme Brahman which the maker of the world had sung of old.

sanskrit: brahmā śatakratur viṣṇur viśvedevā maharṣayaḥ na vidus tvām iti tatas tuṣṭaḥ provāca taṃ śivaḥ
english: "Brahmā, Śatakratu, Viṣṇu, the Viśvedevas, and the great seers know you not" — and at this Śiva, well pleased, then spoke to him.

sanskrit: akṣayaś cāvyayaś caiva bhavitā duḥkhavarjitaḥ yaśasvī tejasā yukto divyajñānasamanvitaḥ
english: "He shall be undecaying and imperishable, free of sorrow, renowned, endowed with splendor, and possessed of divine knowledge."

sanskrit: ṛṣīṇām abhigamyaś ca sūtrakartā sutas tava matprasādād dvijaśreṣṭha bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
english: "Approachable by the seers and a composer of aphorisms, your son shall be, by my grace, O best of the twice-born; of this there is no doubt."

sanskrit: kaṃ vā kāmaṃ dadāmy adya brūhi yad vatsa kāṅkṣase prāñjaliḥ sa uvācedaṃ tvayi bhaktir dṛḍhāstu me
english: "What desire, then, shall I grant you this day? Speak, my child, of what you wish." With folded hands he said this: "Let my devotion to you be firm."

sanskrit: evaṃ dattvā varaṃ devo vandyamānaḥ surarṣibhiḥ stūyamānaś ca vibudhais tatraivāntaradhīyata
english: Having thus granted the boon, the god, revered by the divine seers and praised by the wise, vanished then and there.

sanskrit: antarhite bhagavati sānuge yādaveśvara ṛṣir āśramam āgamya mamaitat proktavān iha
english: When the Lord with his attendants had vanished, O lord of the Yādavas, the seer, having returned to his hermitage, recounted all this to me here.

sanskrit: yāni ca prathitāny ādau taṇḍir ākhyātavān mama nāmāni mānavaśreṣṭha tāni tvaṃ śṛṇu siddhaye
english: And those names, renowned from the first, which Taṇḍi declared to me, O best of men, hear them now for your perfection.
